notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.
goFirst: strategy-concepts §10 [S17] 'the general default is to go second'; go second with counter-heavy and late-game decks. The guide gives no Rocks-specific seat advice.
cardValue: ongoing effects named in the guide's Defining cards (Newgate's +3000, Shiki's −3000, Stussy's [Activate: Main], Captain John's attack lock, Linlin's +1000 on defence).

Every number here is an inference (review M5a-09): the guide gives the direction, not the value. weights, faceBias, counterAggression and cardValue were set by reasoning and have not been tuned on their own.

Bias sizes were chosen so the planted game-plan tests pass; ai/test/game-plan.test.ts runs every seed with the biases off too, and lists the seeds that pass only because a bias encodes the guide's line (docs/benchmarks.md).
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; only biases whose condition is public carry one (avoidPlay does not: its condition is a card in hand).
weights.hand 1.15: the guide calls Rocks 'a blue card-advantage midrange deck' [SH-XEB]; inference: cards in hand weigh a little more.
faceBias 1.0/1.05/1.15: the guide's plan starts Leader attacks at T2 and finishes with OP17-118 [SH-XEB]; inference: slightly more weight on the opponent's Life late.

mulligan: the guide's keepable hand (one early play, plus a counter event or a 5–7 DON!! card; one piece short going second) and SH-XEB's baseline (redraw any hand with no 1- to 3-cost Character going first).

pieces.name: backup
pieces.label: a counter event or a card for 5–7 DON!!

biases.cite: Its guide: start attacking with the Leader, paying for the reveal, from turn 2.
Its guide: pay the reveal cost every time; in this deck the reveal almost always draws 2.
Its guide: Rocks.D.Xebec (10 cost) lands at 10 DON!! and plays two more Rocks Pirates.
Its guide: Stussy keeps your best attacker home.

assertions.text: Leader attacks every turn from T2 in at least 90% of turns where it is active.
Pays the reveal cost on at least 90% of leader attacks when holding 2+ cards.
Plays OP17-118 on the first turn with 10 DON!! when it is in hand, and uses its On Play to put two Characters into play.
Does not play Buckin from hand while OP17-118 is in hand after T3.
Targets Stussy's On Play at the opponent's highest-power Character with base cost 6 or less.
